title: Concept: GlassFish console reachable
description: The GlassFish server console or its default page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The console manages deployments and data sources, and it often runs on a non-standard port that survives network rules written for the application.
applicability: Deployments that render the GlassFish server console or its default page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The console manages deployments and data sources, and it often runs on a non-standard port that survives network rules written for the application.
